user.title: Home Aircon Driver
user.description: What would you like to add?

menu_options.guard: A tank guard (urgent cooling when tank water gets hot)

zone.title: Name the zone
zone.description: For example Lounge or Fish room.

zone_hw.title: Zone sensors and outputs
zone_hw.description: Pick the room temperature sensors that should drive this zone (e.g. your Zigbee sensors). The aircon unit's own reading is only used if every sensor goes quiet. Add at least one output.

data.sensor_max_age_min: Default: treat a sensor as silent after (minutes)
data.dampers: Zone dampers (e.g. AirTouch zone fans, optional)
data.poll_quiet_sensors: Poll quiet sensors (ONLY for cloud/polled sensors; leave OFF for Zigbee - it can hide a dead sensor)

guard_hw.title: Tank guard settings
guard_hw.description: The hottest fresh tank sensor drives the level. If every tank sensor goes silent the guard treats it as critical.

data.zones: Zones to cool when the guard trips
data.hysteresis: Release margin (stay tripped until this far below)
data.stale_min: Treat tank sensors as silent after (minutes)
data.poll_quiet_sensors: Poll quiet sensors (ONLY for cloud/polled sensors; leave OFF for Zigbee - it can hide a dead sensor)

error.name_exists: That name is already in use.
error.need_sensor: Pick at least one temperature sensor.
error.need_output: Pick at least one climate unit, heater or cooler.
error.critical_below_warn: Critical must be higher than warn.

init.title: What would you like to change?

menu_options.timeouts: How long before a sensor counts as silent

hardware.title: Rewire sensors and outputs
hardware.description: Change sensors, outputs or thresholds. Replaced a sensor? Pick the new one here.

data.sensor_max_age_min: Default: treat a sensor as silent after (minutes)
data.zones: Zones to cool when the guard trips
data.hysteresis: Release margin (stay tripped until this far below)
data.stale_min: Treat tank sensors as silent after (minutes)
data.dampers: Zone dampers (e.g. AirTouch zone fans, optional)
data.poll_quiet_sensors: Poll quiet sensors (ONLY for cloud/polled sensors; leave OFF for Zigbee - it can hide a dead sensor)

programs.title: Scheduled programs
programs.description: Each program turns on while its Schedule helper is on (create schedules under Settings > Devices & services > Helpers > Schedule). First matching program wins; outside any program the zone uses its own Mode and Target. Example: winter mornings = heat 21 in Jun-Aug.

data.program1_months: Program 1: only in these months (empty = all year)
data.program2_months: Program 2: only in these months (empty = all year)
data.program3_months: Program 3: only in these months (empty = all year)

timeouts.title: Per-sensor silence limits
timeouts.description: Minutes without a report before each sensor counts as silent. Zigbee sensors that push every few minutes can use a short limit; cloud or polled sensors that only update every few hours need a long one. The entry default is {default} min.

error.need_sensor: Pick at least one temperature sensor.
error.need_output: Pick at least one climate unit, heater or cooler.
error.critical_below_warn: Critical must be higher than warn.

set_override.name: Cool or heat to a temperature
set_override.description: Run a zone until it reaches the target, then return to normal.

max_minutes.name: Max minutes
max_minutes.description: Safety cap on how long the boost may run.
